'''Winati''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who worked for the [[Workers]]. In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], she participated in a secret meeting of a group of miners under the leadership of [[Irini]]. After [[Lenz]] had informed the group that the [[Absolutes]] had begun to monitor the workers, she and [[Mohn]] were commissioned to try and find suitable places for their meeting.
